dataset: Ghaderi, Crochet & Petersen, Nature Communications 2026, DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-73622-y
status: analysis specification frozen before extraction of numeric processed values; not outcome-blinded to the paper's qualitative conclusions
trial_contrast: Go-tone + whisker + lick versus Nogo-tone + whisker + no lick, matching the authors' 50-neuron decoder
causal_outcome: negative of light-minus-no-light change in lick probability (percentage points) on completed Go-tone + whisker trials; positive values indicate behavioral impairment
primary_statistic: within-epoch rank correlation pooled across 15 region-by-epoch cells, with one common region-label permutation applied across all three epochs
primary_test: exact one-sided positive randomization test over all 5! = 120 region-label permutations
secondary: epoch-specific Spearman correlations with exact 5! permutation tests
region-averaged Spearman correlation across five regions
leave-one-region-out linear prediction with epoch fixed effects
success_criterion: primary exact one-sided P < 0.05 and positive primary statistic
